entries.description: The anchored environment_preregistration.json froze the B-variant observation map as o = s mod 4. Because the ring dynamics are additive (s' = s + d mod 12) and the observation map is a congruence, the observation process is lumpable: the next observation class is fully determined by the current observation class and action, for all three displacements. Consequently (a) belief over hidden states carries zero information beyond the current observation, so the latent-dynamics candidate B is structurally equivalent to a memoryless observation predictor in this environment, and (b) KL(P(o'|s,a) || P(o'|o,a)) = 0 for every state-action, so the preregistered B_slice_4 alias-disambiguation mask is empty (0/0, slice undefined).
